import from "./context.ts" { createRuleContext }
import from "./registry.ts" { getRules }

type RuleContext = dict[str, object];
type Warning = dict[str, str];

def:pub analyzeElement(data: dict[str, object]) -> list[Warning] {
    ctx = createRuleContext(data) as RuleContext;
    warnings: list[Warning] = [];
    for rule in getRules() {
        check = rule["check"] as Callable[[RuleContext], list[Warning]];
        warnings.extend(check(ctx));
    }
    return warnings;
}
